capabilities: Show remaining reading time in the status bar
Insert a book progress bar via a code block
Reset reading progress with a code block option
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is brief and points to an animated instruction for enabling remaining reading time on mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read books in the vault or track where you left off, how much reading time remains, or overall progress.
summary: Book reader for Obsidian that remembers scroll position, shows remaining reading time, and tracks reading progress.
